items.label: Voicemail Recording
items.description: 22-second voicemail. Male voice in distress claiming to be a grandson in jail, asking for $5,000 bail. Background sounds consistent with a call center, not a holding cell.

items.label: Voiceprint Comparison
items.description: Spectral overlay of the voicemail voice versus the grandson's actual voice from a school recording. Shows 87% match — close, but the 200-400Hz range shows systematic divergence.

items.label: Call Origin Metadata
items.description: VoIP call routing data. Originated from a number registered to 'VeraTech Solutions LLC'. Routed through three proxy countries before reaching Veritas.

items.label: Suspicious Text Messages
items.description: Text thread between the victim's grandson and an unknown number. Contains links to a 'fun voice changer game' — actually an audio capture script. Three seconds of playback was enough.

items.label: Scammer Profile Photo
items.description: Profile image attached to the scammer's account. Shows a smiling elderly woman. The account lists her as 'Maria Santos, family friend of the Kowalskis.'

items.label: Bank Transaction Records
items.description: Bank records showing a $5,000 payment from VeraTech Solutions LLC to a numbered account. Memo reads 'Harborview deployment — phase 2'. Dated three days before the first scam call.
